name: AWS — Security Hub Disabled Post-Compromise
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("DisableSecurityHub","BatchDisableStandards","UpdateStandardsControl","DeleteInsight")
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as events,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_ips,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.user.username, _time
| fields source_ips, xdm.source.user.username, events_seen
description: DisableSecurityHub, BatchDisableStandards, UpdateStandardsControl, or DeleteInsight event — defense evasion following session hijack.

TA0005 - Defense Evasion: T1562.001 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
